info.name: ERP API (WP0 - WP10)
info.description:
Import into Postman. Run 'npm run db:seed' first.

1. Pick a person in 'Login as ...' (HR, Accounts, Dept Head, Employee ...). The token is saved in {{token}} and used by every request.
2. Create requests save the new id in a collection variable ({{companyId}}, {{employeeId}}, {{requestId}} ...), so folders can be run top to bottom.
3. Write requests send Idempotency-Key: {{$guid}} (new each time). PATCH bodies need the current "version" from the last GET.
4. With SECURITY_MFA_ENFORCED=false in backend/.env (local default) no 2FA codes are needed. With true, privileged users must set up 2FA and step-up routes need header X-OTP-Code.

All demo passwords: Demo-Pass-123

item.name: Payroll - runs, approval, payslips (WP6)
item.description:
The seed has a calculated September 2026 run. Flow:
1. HR: "Runs of a month" (saves {{payrollRunId}}), "Run", clear each flag ("Clear a flag" uses {{payrollFlagId}} saved by "Run"), "Submit".
2. Accounts (sujit.das@demo.test): Approvals / My inbox -> approve (run becomes "verified").
3. Admin (anisur.rahman@demo.test): approve (run becomes "approved"). Sujit can never approve both steps.
4. "Reproduce" re-calculates from the stored inputs: identical = true.
5. Rafi (rafi@demo.test): "My payslips".
A new month needs its attendance locked first (Attendance / Lock month).

item.name: Disbursement and payslips (WP7)
item.description:
Log in as Accounts (sujit.das@demo.test). {{payrollRunId}} must be an APPROVED run (see the WP6 folder).
1. "Payments of the run" saves the first bank/wallet payment id and reference.
2. "Generate file" per channel (bank, bkash, nagad, rocket, upay, cash). Download it, then "Settle" when the bank has paid.
3. Returns: edit the body of "Import return file" with a real reference, then "Re-issue" the returned payment.
4. To regenerate a file: "Cancel file" -> Admin (anisur.rahman@demo.test) approves in Approvals / My inbox -> generate again.
5. When every payment is paid, the run becomes "disbursed".
Payslip PDF: log in as Rafi for "My payslip PDF" (use Send and Download in Postman to save the file).
File formats are ILLUSTRATIVE until each bank / wallet provider confirms its own layout.

item.name: Data migration (WP8)
item.description:
HR (farzana.akter@demo.test) loads the data; Admin (anisur.rahman@demo.test) signs the reconciliation.
Sample files for Demo Trading Ltd: backend/samples/migration/1-employees.csv ... 6-bank_accounts.csv (cut-over 2026-10-01).
For each file, in order: Upload (pick the file in the body) -> Batch (see row errors) -> Skip a row if needed -> Dry run -> Commit.
1-employees.csv has one bad row (row 5) on purpose: skip it with a reason, then commit.
Rollback works until the sign-off; employees cannot be rolled back while later batches use them.

item.name: Notifications (WP10)
item.description:
In-app inbox of the signed-in user (any login), and the e-mail / SMS delivery log (Admin / System Admin: integrations.manage).
The n8n relay routes (claim, result, attachment) need the per-event callback token that only n8n receives; they are not for manual use. See n8n/README.md.

item.name: AI (WP11)
item.description: AI gateway, assistant and payroll flag explanations. Which model answers is set by AI_PROVIDER in backend/.env (off / fake / anthropic). The demo workspace is on the Intelligent plan with AI switched on and the handbook loaded (npm run db:seed). Assistant: log in as Rafi (employee). Settings and usage: Anisur (Admin). Policy documents: Farzana (HR). Flag explanation: Sujit (Accounts) or Farzana, with payrollFlagId saved from GET /payroll-runs/:runId. The AI routes need no Idempotency-Key: they change no business data.

item.description: Employee audit fixes. Probation: the Dept Head recommends (confirm, extend, end), HR decides; the worker reminds the Dept Head 15 days before the end. Leaving: HR records the notice (resignation, termination, retirement, contract end); the notice given is checked against the company's notice period (placeholders: 60 / 120 days). IT, Admin, Accounts and the Dept Head clear the leaver; the final settlement run is refused until all four are done (HR may clear any). The approved final settlement separates the employee; then the experience certificate. Notice periods and retirement age are company settings.
